decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.3234. Series context: trend strength 0.9692 and seasonal strength 0.0207; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.478); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 43.375.
